summary.text: Keith Brusseau is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 98, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A machinist and U.S. Army Reserve veteran, he advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Brusseau served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 1994 to 2000.
He graduated from Warren Mott High School, earned an associate degree from American Business and Technology University, and has worked as a machinist.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Brusseau said his only concern is the interest of voters and that he opposes what he described as the growing influence of business interests at the expense of the public.
He also said the best way to encourage jobs and businesses in the state is through tax breaks for spending money locally.
